IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.external_file_formats WHERE name = 'SynapseDelimitedTextFormat') 
	CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT [SynapseDelimitedTextFormat] 
	WITH ( FORMAT_TYPE = DELIMITEDTEXT ,
	       FORMAT_OPTIONS (
			 FIELD_TERMINATOR = ',',
			 FIRST_ROW = 2,
			 USE_TYPE_DEFAULT = FALSE
			))
GO

IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.external_data_sources WHERE name = 'source_storageaccount069_dfs_core_windows_net') 
	CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE [source_storageaccount069_dfs_core_windows_net] 
	WITH (
		LOCATION = 'abfss://source@storageaccount069.dfs.core.windows.net' 
	)
GO

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.socialmedia (
	[Student_ID] bigint,
	[Age] bigint,
	[Gender] nvarchar(4000),
	[Academic_Level] nvarchar(4000),
	[Country] nvarchar(4000),
	[Avg_Daily_Usage_Hours] float,
	[Most_Used_Platform] nvarchar(4000),
	[Affects_Academic_Performance] nvarchar(4000),
	[Sleep_Hours_Per_Night] float,
	[Mental_Health_Score] bigint,
	[Relationship_Status] nvarchar(4000),
	[Conflicts_Over_Social_Media] bigint,
	[Addicted_Score] bigint
	)
	WITH (
	LOCATION = 'csvfile/Students Social Media Addiction.csv',
	DATA_SOURCE = [source_storageaccount069_dfs_core_windows_net],
	FILE_FORMAT = [SynapseDelimitedTextFormat]
	)
GO


SELECT TOP 100 * FROM dbo.socialmedia
GO
